UI separates review, Central request and explicit execution confirmation; displays current pending requests, discards late/foreign-user responses, recovers uncertain operations by server read, and renews request intent after changed policy/history without duplicating retries.
Central popup opens authorized reviewed source without voting. Detailed native JSON report includes captured transfer facts and identifiers; no tokens or full private source documents added.
